I'm sorry it's tweaky. Anything that feels off in a shoulder is one for a doctor or physio to look at, not a coach, so I'd get it checked before loading it further.

On the program side, I can take incline bench out of your plan while you get it looked at. Tell me the day it sits on, or say "remove incline bench" and I'll queue the change for you to confirm. I've queued the removal of incline bench from your program. Check the change and tap to confirm when it looks right.

Once the physio has cleared you, tell me what they say and we'll bring it back at whatever weight and volume fits.
